name: AVD CTA Insights
author: Alexander van Dijl

sections.description:
AVD CTA Insights helps WordPress site owners measure visitor behaviour, improve CTA performance and receive AI-powered conversion recommendations.
Features include:

  • CTA click tracking
  • Visitor Intelligence
  • Conversion statistics
  • AI-based optimization suggestions
  • AI Action Center
  • Configurable CTA Templates
  • Live Events
  • Bot and suspicious-event filtering

The plugin does not automatically modify website content in the current release.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate AVD CTA Insights.
  2. Open AVD CTA Insights in the WordPress admin menu.
  3. Review the dashboard and settings.
  4. Configure CTA Templates if needed.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin automatically change my website?

No. The current release only provides analysis, recommendations and previews.

Does the plugin send analytics data to an external server?

No. Tracking data is stored inside the WordPress installation.
sections.changelog:
4.0.0.18

  • Fixed the admin tracking test after the AJAX action rename.
  • Added recovery for legacy AVD tracking data without deleting old options.
  • Added a durable event archive so statistics no longer disappear when the recent-event buffer reaches its limit.
  • Restored archived events in dashboard and AI statistics.

4.0.0.15

  • Made frontend tracking and dashboard integration more robust.
  • Removed hardcoded site-specific contact details from the default plugin configuration.
  • Added configurable CTA, phone and WhatsApp settings.
  • Improved dashboard, settings, asset loading and WordPress.org deployment compatibility.

4.0.0.13

  • Eerste officiële release van AVD CTA Insights.
  • CTA-klikken en bezoekersgedrag meten.
  • Conversie-inzichten en optimalisatievoorstellen in het WordPress-dashboard.
  • Ondersteuning voor live events, sessies, apparaten en pagina-analyse.
  • Voorbereid voor publicatie in de WordPress Plugin Directory.

3.9.0.1

  • Renamed the plugin to AVD CTA Insights.
  • Prepared the plugin for WordPress.org review.
  • Added AI Learn page benchmarking.
  • Improved Visitor Intelligence.
  • Removed remaining WordPress.org review issues.

3.8.4

  • Prepared the plugin for WordPress.org.
  • Added bot and suspicious-event filtering.
  • Improved dashboard structure.
  • Added CTA previews in the AI Action Center.
  • Removed the external updater from the directory build.
